data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient legible data was available in the provided images to extract a definitive gross opening claims outstanding balance or a clearly stated gross prior year reserve movement. The published claims development table (gross) and the total gross claims reserve at 31 December 2018 are visible, but the prior-year comparative (opening) figure and an explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note are not clearly legible in the supplied pages. As a result, prior year development and per-line movements could not be reliably quantified from the images provided.
data.data_quality_notes: The supplied document images are low resolution for many numeric tables. The Balance Sheet line 'Claims outstanding' (gross) prior-year comparative could not be read with confidence. The claims development (gross) triangle is present and legible enough to extract the total gross claims reserve at 31/12/2018 (680,942 in GBP 000), but the explicit prior-year opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2017) figure is not clearly legible on the Balance Sheet image. The note that specifically quantifies 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in gross terms could not be found in a legible form. Where a clear numeric value was visible (total gross claims reserve at 31 Dec 2018 = GBP 680,942k) that is referenced in the background, but per the instructions the opening_reserves (1 Jan 2018) must be the prior-year comparative from the Balance Sheet - this specific prior-year cell was not unambiguously readable, so it is returned as null. The gross written premium for 2018 (523,224) was visible in the Managing Agent summary table; that value is returned above. The claims development triangle exists (pages ~39-40) and is in thousands (GBP), but many intermediate diagonal numbers are partially obscured; therefore a full, reliable diagonal-based prior year development calculation was not performed. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF can be provided, I can extract precise opening reserves, the gross prior-year development and map line-of-business movements and named events with high confidence.
